content.title: Chwalinska rallies past Kartal to claim first WTA title Wuhan
content.description: Maja Chwalinska's breakout season reached a new high Sunday night as the No. 16 seed rallied from a set and a break down to defeat World No. 170 Sonay Kartal 2-6, 6-4, 6-2 in 2 hours, 43 minutes and capture her first WTA title in Wuhan.

content.title: Dabrowski, Stefani triumph in Wuhan for sixth title of the season
content.description: Top seeds Gabriela Dabrowski and Luisa Stefani defeated No. 3 seeds Storm Hunter and Katerina Siniakova 7-5, 6-4 to win the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open on Sunday. The victory marked the pair’s sixth title of the season and third in a row.

content.title: Qualified! How Elina Svitolina made the WTA Finals Indian Wells
content.description: Elina Svitolina has become the seventh player to qualify for the 2026 WTA Finals Indian Wells. Here's how she did it.

content.title: Chwalinska beats Swiatek to reach first WTA 1000 final in Wuhan
content.description: French Open runner-up Maja Chwalinska advanced to her first WTA 1000 final with a 7-5, 6-1 win over fellow Pole Iga Swiatek in the semifinals of the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open. Chwalinska will face Great Britain's Sonay Kartal for the title Sunday.

content.title: In the clutch! Kartal upsets Ostapenko in pair of tiebreaks to reach Wuhan final
content.description: With clutch play in tiebreaks, World No. 170 Sonay Kartal upset Jelena Ostapenko 7-6(9), 7-6(5) in the Wuhan semifinals to advance to her second tour-level final. She's on the verge of her second career tour-level title after winning Monastir in 2024.

content.title: Swiatek ends Li's dream run to reach first Wuhan semifinal
content.description: Iga Swiatek rolled into her first Wuhan semifinal Friday night, defeating an in-form Ann Li 6-4, 6-1 in 1 hour, 33 minutes. The former World No. 1 won seven of the final eight games to set up an all-Polish showdown with Maja Chwalinska.

content.title: Chwalinska edges Sakkari in Wuhan thriller; into second SF of Asian Swing
content.description: No. 16 seed Maja Chwalinska booked her spot in her third tour-level semifinal, second of the Asian Swing and second at WTA 1000 level or above with a 6-0, 3-6, 7-5 defeat of Maria Sakkari in 2 hours and 35 minutes at the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open. Chwalinska improved to 2-1 against Sakkari (and 2-0 in 2026) in their first hard-court meeting.

content.title: Chwalinska finds pinpoint right-handed lob sets up backhand winner in Wuhan
content.description: Maja Chwalinska was stretched so far wide by Maria Sakkari's attempted one-two punch in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open quarterfinals that the left-handed Pole had to use her right hand just to get the ball back in play. No matter -- even with her non-dominant hand, Chwalinska's touch was supreme. She reset the point with a perfectly weighted lob, and ultimately finished it off with a backhand winner on the line.

content.title: Kartal stuns Svitolina in Wuhan to reach first WTA 1000 semifinal
content.description: In just her third tournament since returning from a six-month layoff due to a back injury, Sonay Kartal upset No. 5 seed Elina Svitolina 6-2, 2-6, 6-4 at the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open to reach her first career WTA 1000 semifinal. The result was the Briton's first win over Svitolina in three meetings, including a third-set tiebreak loss in the Auckland quarterfinals in January, and her second career Top 10 victory (following her defeat of Mirra Andreeva at Beijing 2025).

content.title: Hot shot: Jelena Ostapenko's forehand slice winner on the run in Wuhan
content.description: Jelena Ostapenko was in the zone for much of her Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open quarterfinal against Diana Shnaider -- even pulling off a forehand slice winner down the line on the run in this point in the second set. One point later, she hammered a more customary return winner into the same corner of Shnaider's court.

content.title: Ostapenko saves two set points, fires 32 winners to beat Shnaider in Wuhan
content.description: Jelena Ostapenko came from 5-2 down in the first set, saving two set points along the way, to defeat No. 11 seed Diana Shnaider 7-6(6), 6-1 in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open quarterfinals. Ostapenko advanced to her second WTA 1000 semifinal of 2026 (following Doha) and second in Wuhan (following her 2017 run). Ostapenko's 32 winners in the match take her tally for the week to 138.

content.title: Li breaks through to first WTA 1000 quarterfinal in with Wuhan win over Tjen
content.description: Ann Li backed up her upset of top seed Aryna Sabalenka by defeating Janice Tjen in straight sets Thursday night in Wuhan, advancing to the first WTA 1000 quarterfinal of her career.

content.title: Swiatek holds off Krueger to reach second straight Wuhan quarterfinal
content.description: Iga Swiatek advanced to her second consecutive Wuhan quarterfinal Thursday night with a 6-1, 6-4 victory over lucky loser Ashlyn Krueger. The win also keeps her hopes of qualifying for the WTA Finals alive.

content.title: Shnaider on rollercoaster win over Muchova to move on in Wuhan
content.description: After a back-and-forth match that was anything but easy, Diana Shnaider talked about how she stayed locked in and why she was so happy to come through in two sets.

content.title: Kartal routs Paolini in 63 minutes in Wuhan; into second WTA 1000 QF
content.description: In her third tournament following a six-month layoff due to a back injury, Sonay Kartal defeated No. 15 seed Jasmine Paolini 6-2, 6-0 -- winning the last 11 straight games -- at the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open to reach her second career WTA 1000 quarterfinal (following Beijing 2025).

content.title: Ostapenko edges Fernandez in another rollercoaster to make Wuhan quarters
content.description: Jelena Ostapenko came through a second consecutive three-set rollercoaster at the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open to defeat Leylah Fernandez 6-1, 1-6, 6-4 in 1 hour and 56 minutes. Ostapenko improved to 2-0 against Fernandez and advanced to her third WTA 1000 quarterfinal of 2026, and first in Wuhan since 2017.

content.title: Chwalinska drops five games vs. Jovic in Wuhan; into fourth QF of 2026
content.description: In a first-time meeting in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open third round, No. 16 seed Maja Chwalinska defeated No. 10 seed Iva Jovic 6-4, 6-1 to score her second career Top 20 win and advance to her fourth tour-level quarterfinal of 2026 (and second at WTA 1000 level or above).

content.title: Sakkari holds off Pohankova to return to Wuhan quarters after nine years
content.description: Maria Sakkari held off a late charge from 5-1 down in the second set by 17-year-old wild card Mia Pohankova to win their Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open third-round tilt 6-1, 6-4. Sakkari advanced to her second Wuhan quarterfinal, and first since her 2017 semifinal run. She also advanced to her second WTA 1000 quarterfinal of 2026 following Doha.

content.title: Svitolina ends Guo's dream run to reach third Wuhan quarterfinal
content.description: No. 5 seed Elina Svitolina defeated wild card Guo Hanyu 6-1, 6-4 in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open third round, advancing to her third quarterfinal at the tournament following 2014 and 2019.

content.title: 'Harry Potter stuff out there!' Shnaider's cat-and-mouse magic in Wuhan
content.description: There was a plethora of hot shots in this exchange between Diana Shnaider and Karolina Muchova in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open third round, from Karolina Muchova's pickup serve-and-volley to Shnaider's lob on the stretch, then reflex volley off a Muchova overhead. But having been dragged into the forecourt, Shnaider held firm, and ultimately won the cat-and-mouse battle with a clever wrong-footing forehand.

content.title: Shnaider upsets Muchova for fourth career Top 10 win
content.description: No. 11 seed Diana Shnaider needed 1 hour, 55 minutes to upset No. 6 seed Karolina Muchova 7-6, 6-3 and reach the quarterfinals of the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open. Shnaider, who has reached the quarterfinals at the WTA 1000 level for the fourth time, will face either Leylah Fernandez or Jelena Ostapenko next.

content.title: Fernandez wins final five games to oust Shi in Wuhan second round
content.description: Leylah Fernandez erased a 4-1 second-set deficit Wednesday night in Wuhan, reeling off the final five games to defeat home favorite Shi Han in straight sets and reach the Round of 16. She will face Jelena Ostapenko next.

content.title: Finally! On 10th match point, Li completes upset of Sabalenka at the Wuhan Open
content.description: Ann Li secured the biggest win of her career in dramatic fashion Wednesday night in Wuhan, rallying from a set down and needing 10 match points to finally put away top seed Aryna Sabalenka 3-6, 6-4, 7-6 (5) in 2 hours, 27 minutes.

content.title: Krueger wins clash of lucky losers vs. Tararudee to make Wuhan last 16
content.description: A clash of lucky losers in the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open second round saw Ashlyn Krueger recover to defeat Lanlana Tararudee 2-6, 6-1, 6-1.

content.title: Guo's dream Wuhan run continues with 3:04 marathon victory over Volynets
content.description: Chinese wild card Guo Hanyu's dream run at the Dongfeng • Voyah Wuhan Open continued with a 6-4, 4-6, 7-6(3) victory over qualifier Katie Volynets to reach the third round, marking the first time she has won consecutive matches in a WTA main draw.

content.description: Xiyu Wang shared how much the support of a home crowd means to her, and how her recent Asian Games run has her feeling more like herself on court.
